name: from_raw_parts
declaration: unsafe fn from_raw_parts (buf : * mut u8 , length : usize , capacity : usize) -> String
rules: If buf points to a C char array containing UTF-8, constructing a String from it is normally not safe unless the array was originally allocated by the Rust standard library's allocator.

After String::from_raw_parts(buf, length, capacity) is called, nothing else may use buf; ownership has transferred to the returned String, which may deallocate, reallocate, or change the pointed-to memory.
